To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the style mechanism is a central and powerful mechanism for document editing.
document style is the most important aspect of document formatting and that document style mechanisms are the most critical aspect of document editing systems.
the design space for document styles is large, the design issues are many, and the research issues are numerous.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a document editing system that is capable of providing a wide variety of styles.
the development of a new style system that is both powerful and simple to use.
the problem of providing a style language for document editors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no single best style mechanism, but rather that the choice of mechanism is dependent on the application and the user.
the design of a style mechanism for a document editing system should be based on a thorough analysis of the document types that will be edited.

the design issues of document style mechanisms are not fully understood, that the state of the art in document editing systems is far from mature, and that there are a number of major style issues that remain unresolved.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the style mechanism of a document editing system is the mechanism by which the user can define and manipulate the style of a document, where style is defined as those properties of the text that can be changed without changing the meaning of the text, and the document is defined as a collection of text and graphics that can be printed on a page.

we have shown that document editing systems can support a wide variety of style mechanisms, that they can be designed to support a variety of styles, that the style mechanisms that are supported can be changed dynamically, and that style can be used to support the creation, maintenance, and presentation of documents.

we have developed a framework and tools for the development of document editing systems that can be used to create a wide range of document styles, including those that support multiple views of the same data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no one right way to do style, and there is a need to provide a variety of style mechanisms in order to support the variety of styles that are used.
style is a complex and multifaceted issue.
there are many different ways to support styles in document editors.
